newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude seen down five cents at open, drifting.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude seen down five cents at open, drifting.

text.p: Crude oil futures are expected to open about five cents lower Monday and traders said the market shows no clear signs of which direction it is likely to move.
June crude closed down four cents Friday at $19.99 a barrel and has traded between $19.97 and $19.85 in out-of-hours trading since. In London, Brent was up three cents at 0930 EDT at $18.30.
"Maybe if we get back above $20.25 we'll see some stops (stop-loss buy orders). But there is no strong momentum either way," said Tom Bentz, a trader at ING Derivatives in New York.
